rationale: Roberts, as the assigning justice in a narrow 5-4 majority with near-equipoise confidence, is most likely to assign to himself to write a narrow, institutionally cautious opinion, though Thomas or Alito may receive the assignment given their higher confidence and cleaner textualist framing. The four dissenters, particularly Sotomayor and Jackson who have already written publicly on this issue, are highly likely to author or join a dissent, while Kavanaugh and Thomas may write separately to address the structural arguments they found most challenging.
